title: Mesh Memory Protocol claim fields (CAT7-inspired)

field_notes.claim: Distilled assertion Cam is willing to store — not raw peer chat
field_notes.parents: Content-hash or mesh keys this claim remixes (lineage)
field_notes.accessed: ISO-8601 date the sources were accessed

remix_rules: Receivers accept field-by-field (SVAF-style); never whole-blob peer dumps into mesh/facts
Store role-evaluated remix only — never raw peer signal as truth
center.qa may veto missing citations or lineage on non-trivial claims
AGI scan / vision / careers write distillates first; curator promotes to facts
